title: SRD importer: capture chapter/appendix intro prose hidden by ignored:document-structure
description: Follow-up to PR #222 audit. Chapter/appendix/subclass-category intro prose is being dropped as ignored:document-structure even when it carries gameplay rules or source context. Import/attach the remaining gameplay-relevant intro prose and harden coverage so ignored:document-structure cannot silently hide rules text. Findings: (1) Feats optional-rule prose; (2) Conditions general rules; (3) Using Ability Scores chapter intro; (4) subclass category overviews; (5) Appendix MM-B intro; (6) harden ignored:document-structure guard. Ground truth confirmed from SRD PDF: Feats intro p75 lines1-17 ('Using the optional feats rule'); Conditions intro p358 lines1-15 ('A condition lasts either until it is countered', 'the condition's effects don't get worse'); UAS intro p76 ('Six abilities provide a quick description'); MM-B preamble p395 lines1-6 ('This appendix contains statistics for various humanoid nonplayer characters'); 8 subclass-category h=18 headings (Martial Archetypes p25, Monastic Traditions p28, Sacred Oaths p32, Ranger Archetypes p37, Roguish Archetypes p40, Sorcerous Origins p44, Otherworldly Patrons p50, Arcane Traditions p54). Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken tests/audit.
close_reason: All children implemented and handed off in PR #227.
